en.t: She wrote only a few words, then stopped her brush there.

units.source_text: 将信两端捻封，掷出帘外。

en.t: She twisted the two ends of the letter shut and threw it out beyond the curtain.

units.source_text: 立刻躺下身子，但觉异常痛苦。

en.t: She immediately lay down, but felt an extraordinary anguish.

units.source_text: 众侍女推想刚才是鬼怪一时疏忽，暂不侵扰之故，

en.t: The serving women supposed that just now the spirit had been careless for a moment and had stopped troubling her for a while,
and so they began to panic and make a commotion.

units.source_text: 正在祈祷的几位灵验的法师就又开始大声诵念。

en.t: The several powerful priests who were praying then began chanting loudly again.

units.source_text: 众侍女劝请公主：“还是回去的好。”

en.t: The serving women urged the princess, "It would be better for you to go back after all."

units.source_text: 但公主自伤命薄，情愿与母同死，一直守候在旁。

en.t: But the princess lamented her own ill fate and, willing to die together with her mother, kept watch at her side the whole time.
